content.title: Dodgers vs. Rockies: Prediction, Lineups, How to Watch (4/20/26)
content.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers (15–6) and the Colorado Rockies (9–13) wrap up a four-game series tonight at Coors Field. The Dodgers have lost the last two games in this set with the Rockies, falling on Sunday, 9–6. L.A. got out to a 3–0 lead on RBI hits by Alex Freeland, Shohei Ohtani, and Ryan Ward in the third and fourth innings. Colorado evened it up after scoring in the third and fourth, including on a Kyle Karros solo homer. Freeland put the Dodgers back on top with another RBI single, but then the Rockies broke the game open with a two-run homer from Mickey Moniak and a two-run single from Edouard Julien. Moniak and Julien combined for five hits and six RBIs, as Colorado continues to showcase a much-improved offense from last year’s 119-loss season. Roki Sasaki struggled once again, giving up three runs and seven hits in just 4.2 innings. Blake Treinen got the loss after giving up three runs in relief without recording an out. Justin Wrobleski (2-0, 2.12 ERA) gets the start for Los Angeles against José Quintana (0-1, 5.63 ERA) for Colorado. Wrobleski was brilliant in his last outing, pitching eight scoreless innings against the hapless New York Mets, allowing just two hits. Quintana has struggled in both of his starts this season. He gave up three runs in 3.2 innings last week against the Houston Astros, walking four. Expect the Dodgers to bounce back with the edge tonight on the mound and at the plate. Final Score Prediction: Los Angeles Dodgers 6, Colorado Rockies 3 Starting Lineups Los Angeles Dodgers Shohei Ohtani — DH Alex Call — RF Will Smith — C Teoscar Hernández — LF Andy Pages — CF Miguel Rojas — SS Max Muncy — 3B Santiago Espinal — 2B Dalton Rushing — 1B Starting Pitcher: Justin Wrobleski (LHP) — 2-0, 2.12 ERA, 6 K Colorado Rockies Jordan Beck — LF Brenton Doyle — CF Hunter Goodman — DH Tyler Freeman — RF Ezequiel Tovar — SS Troy Johnston — 1B Willi Castro — 2B Kyle Karros — 3B Brett Sullivan — C Starting Pitcher: José Quintana (LHP) — 0-1, 5.63 ERA, 3 K How to Watch Dodgers vs. Rockies First pitch is scheduled for 8:40 PM Eastern / 6:40 PM Mountain / 5:40 PM Pacific at Coors Field in Denver.
